authority: proposed responsibility grouping, not a new implementation mandate

hpx.native.domain.title: Pure domain
hpx.native.domain.summary: Deterministic identities, exact ranges and bounded plans.
hpx.native.domain.description: Dependency-free typed identities and byte/UTF16 validation; bounded supplied expansion, assertion/comment, independent Fork/Synthesis and supplied-map parent-Merge planning. No serialization, entropy, authorization or I/O. Full nested-closure and multi-owner plans remain incomplete.

hpx.native.application.title: Command and publication coordinator
hpx.native.application.summary: Authorize, plan, recheck and publish one atomic result.
hpx.native.application.description: Logical application coordinator currently hosted in Workspace::execute/execute_inner in crates/storage. Validates frozen commands, checks current sole-owner authority before protected receipt replay, rechecks expected state, and atomically publishes bounded local results and receipts. Changed operation reuse conflicts; unknown outcomes reconcile the original request. Not a separate crate, process or general distributed transaction service.

hpx.native.authority.title: Authority and confidentiality policy
hpx.native.authority.summary: Current owner scope; broader rights and egress gates remain planned.
hpx.native.authority.description: Current catalog owner/device/membership and source/result scope checks are independent of IDs, session authentication and prior receipts. General grants, revocation, historical disclosure, rights evidence and client-held core egress checks remain planned. Every future provider/file/clipboard/print/job sink must enforce the adopted mode policy below its UI. No new policy engine, identity provider or permission scheme is selected.

hpx.native.documents.title: Documents, branches and working edits
hpx.native.documents.summary: Create, Save, Commit, branch, Fork and reviewed Synthesis.
hpx.native.documents.description: Owns bounded local document/branch drafts, exact generation/base/sequence checks, departure Commit, immutable checkpoints and distinct cross-identity derivation versus same-node history. Existing independent Synthesis is not parent-branch Merge. Pure supplied-map parent-Merge and disposable schema3 single-parent temporal foundations do not deliver production two-parent publication, upgrade or normal opening.

hpx.native.composition.title: Composition and source ownership
hpx.native.composition.summary: Single-occurrence foundation; general composition remains gated.
hpx.native.composition.description: Manifests and exact owned context exist for the current one-owner whole-document slice. General chapter collections, ordered repeated/nested occurrences, promotion/split, multi-owner edit plans, Move/Fork/Embed, pinned/live transclusion and complete cycle/permission revalidation remain target responsibilities, not enabled services. No new entity schema, CRDT, closure cache or resolver algorithm is selected.

hpx.native.queries.title: Graph navigation and read projections
hpx.native.queries.summary: Bounded, authorized graph views; general queries remain planned.
hpx.native.queries.description: Current induced document/Fork, assertion incidence and transformation projections retain roles, direction, exact selected context, outside-selection counts and work limits. General nodes/references/backlinks/occurrences, impact/search/index families and concept/assertion-to-assertion navigation remain unimplemented or unspecified. No separate graph database or authoritative semantic store is introduced.

hpx.native.history.title: Snapshots, history and exact anchors
hpx.native.history.summary: Read retained exact states without following newer heads.
hpx.native.history.description: One-occurrence snapshot reconstruction, immutable history/branch paging, exact historical byte-range reads and bounded common-base inspection exist. Complete nested closure/source maps, general reconstruction compiler resources and all-history navigation remain separate requirements. Reference cycles differ from recursive expansion cycles; inspection cannot mutate snapshots or publish history.

hpx.native.provenance.title: Derivation and contributor evidence
hpx.native.provenance.summary: Pinned derivation and publisher facts, not inferred authorship.
hpx.native.provenance.description: Current immutable Fork/Synthesis/working-source derivations and bounded snapshot-bound publication contributors preserve exact source identities and original-authorship uncertainty. Full observed/declared/inferred authorship, influence, interaction capture, adoption, rights attribution and verification remain distinct future requirements. No authenticated-peer or complete contributor-index claim.

hpx.native.assertions.title: Semantic assertions and predicate catalogue
hpx.native.assertions.summary: Versioned, role-labelled claims and retrospective review.
hpx.native.assertions.description: Current predicates, exact participant captures, n-ary roles, negation/certainty/attribution/scope and revisioned review overlays are separate from text snapshots and browsing categories. Manual contextual equivalence is not automatic discovery, a checked proof or identity equality. General semantic entities and structured evidence remain future scope; owner-deferred statement-to-Lean conversion is not enabled.

hpx.native.comments.title: Anchored document comments
hpx.native.comments.summary: Immutable retrospective comments on committed passages.
hpx.native.comments.description: Current exact committed-source comments and bounded append-only paging preserve historical anchors. Draft anchors, replies, editing, resolution, shared-user lifecycle and imported Word threads remain future scope. Comments are user annotations, not agent conversation or changes to earlier text snapshots.

hpx.native.clipboard.title: Private provenance clipboard
hpx.native.clipboard.summary: Encrypted references, working checkpoints and retained promotions.
hpx.native.clipboard.description: Current principal/workspace-isolated committed and working references, immutable exact checkpoints, independent working-source Fork, promotion and separately acknowledged replacements retain originals. Capture is not Commit or derivation. Full atomic Paste All, multi-component selections and general entity replacement remain gated. Ordinary OS copy/paste executes in the browser and is a separate egress sink.

hpx.native.storage.title: Workspace persistence and record codecs
hpx.native.storage.summary: Versioned encrypted records, slots and atomic SQLite transactions.
hpx.native.storage.description: Current adapter-owned typed records and explicit version/kind wrappers; bundled SQLite objects/slots and authoritative receipts; generation/head checks, bounded consistent read views and WAL/FULL publication. Schema1/2 ordinary opening remains separate from disposable experimental schema3 records. Not every index is reconstructible. No new schema/envelope/API version, pruning or real-data format acceptance follows from this diagram.

hpx.native.recovery.title: Integrity audit and recovery boundaries
hpx.native.recovery.summary: Read-only bounded audit and backed-up enrollment; wider repair is planned.
hpx.native.recovery.description: Current original-branch immediate-record audit, fail-closed decoding, durable draft/receipt recovery and verified backup before explicit keychain upgrade have bounded implementation evidence. Full repair/rebuild/portable restore, power-loss coverage and long-history temporal upgrade remain separate gates. OWNER-009 keeps required persistent application/recovery evidence in the workspace; complete authentic rollback is undetectable and no external witness is introduced.

hpx.native.crypto.title: Authenticated envelopes and managed keys
hpx.native.crypto.summary: Context-bound encryption, entropy and bounded key wrapping.
hpx.native.crypto.description: Current XChaCha20-Poly1305 object envelopes, Argon2id passphrase/device wrapping, OS randomness, separate ciphertext addresses and zeroizing managed buffers. Expected workspace/kind/identity/generation bindings come from the application. Key rotation, group hierarchy, signatures, selective historical key grants and hostile-host protection are not delivered by byte encryption. Crypto decides no authorization.

hpx.native.keychain.title: Explicit native unlock lifecycle
hpx.native.keychain.summary: Optional macOS device secret; passphrase recovery retained.
hpx.native.keychain.description: Current explicit status/enroll/unlock/remove, verified schema2 upgrade and checked native-provider cleanup. Device secret, workspace key, human passphrase and TLS key are distinct. No startup enrollment, plaintext fallback or user workspace mutation as a test effect. Non-macOS provider support, rotation and broader lifecycle remain unavailable or gated.

hpx.native.transport.title: Startup, HTTPS and API adapters
hpx.native.transport.summary: Loopback TLS, sessions, bounded routing and API1 DTOs.
hpx.native.transport.description: Current supplied TLS certificate/key, numeric loopback Host, same-origin requests, bounded headers/body/workers/deadlines, launch capability exchange, secure cookie, locked startup, passphrase unlock and command/read routing. Generated OpenAPI3.1 coverage is progressive; route-only bodies remain untyped. The feature-gated schema exporter is development tooling. Future REST/MCP clients must share application authority/receipt semantics; remote listeners, WSS and general login are not inferred.

hpx.native.frontend_assets.title: Embedded frontend resources
hpx.native.frontend_assets.summary: Static browser assets served from the executable.
hpx.native.frontend_assets.description: Generated immutable asset map embeds HTML/CSS/JavaScript and reviewed notices. CodeMirror, KaTeX, editing, Navigator, graph drawing and source/selection/Undo presentation execute in the browser, not as Rust components. Node/esbuild and Lean are build/assurance tools. Planned local spell checking must follow approved packaging and privacy; its native/browser allocation is unselected.

hpx.native.integrations.title: External integration adapters (planned)
hpx.native.integrations.summary: Scoped agent, citations, import/export, GitHub and federation adapters.
hpx.native.integrations.description: Specified future integration responsibilities within the native application boundary, not selected services, vendors, endpoints, persistence formats or converter processes. Every execution rechecks current authorization and confidentiality/egress policy; client-held/non-trusted plaintext egress remains denied. C3 summarizes these planned adapters; their detailed source-linked responsibilities remain in the model.

hpx.native.integrations.agents.title: Agent context and proposal adapter
hpx.native.integrations.agents.summary: Freeze disclosure and proposals; retain observable interaction evidence.
hpx.native.integrations.agents.description: Human and agent principals remain distinct. Freeze exact permitted context, model/actor attribution, expected targets and approval scope; record prompts/responses/tool interactions only where observable. Model output has no mutation authority. Provider protocol, session and interaction storage remain unselected.

hpx.native.integrations.citations.title: Zotero citation adapters
hpx.native.integrations.citations.summary: Separate desktop-local and cloud read-only access.
hpx.native.integrations.citations.description: Separately selected/authenticated desktop REST and cloud Web API interfaces. Capture exact bibliographic metadata and style resources for reconstruction; no write-back, live historical refresh or automatic fallback. Credentials/origins/contracts remain open.

hpx.native.integrations.word_import.title: Document and Word-review import
hpx.native.integrations.word_import.summary: Bound untrusted parsing and produce a reviewed exact import plan.
hpx.native.integrations.word_import.description: Exact base/target, source-file digest, change/comment mappings and ambiguity diagnostics precede authorization/publication. Retain Word Revision attribution and separate importing/approving humans. No macro execution, remote resource fetching, guessed matching, parser package or portable format selected.

hpx.native.integrations.export.title: Frozen export and academic compilation
hpx.native.integrations.export.summary: Authorized exact content, citations, supplements and rights reports.
hpx.native.integrations.export.description: Freeze branch/snapshot or acknowledged draft, complete permitted closure, overlays/roles, bibliographic/style resources and target profile. Preserve Markdown/PDF/HTML obligations and RQ-030 docx/odt/rtf/html/tex/typ/xml/json targets, with declared fallbacks and permitted unresolved-rights appendix. Bundled/embedded Pandoc mechanism is open; no standalone runtime helper is selected. Exact temporary Markdown download remains a browser function.

hpx.native.integrations.github_jobs.title: GitHub jobs, backup and update adapter
hpx.native.integrations.github_jobs.summary: Separate reviewed publication, encrypted backup and release discovery.
hpx.native.integrations.github_jobs.description: Frozen approved inputs, exact remote concurrency conditions and durable encrypted job/outbox outcomes must reconcile unknown results without promising exactly-once writes. Create-only encrypted backup/restore and release authenticity, installation origin, explicit install/restart approval remain separately gated. No provider connection, remote format, automatic updater or artifact-signing protocol is selected.

hpx.native.integrations.federation.title: Peer exchange and synchronization adapter
hpx.native.integrations.federation.summary: Future authorized offline exchange and coediting interfaces.
hpx.native.integrations.federation.description: Future cross-instance operation validation, exact context, membership/revocation, causal ordering and deterministic conflict handling must preserve common application semantics and retained history. TLS/SQLite/CRDT alone establish none of these. No MLS, network topology, replication protocol or client-held executor is adopted.

relationships.title: Protected read services (area summary)
relationships.scope: Overview aggregation of existing protected read handlers, not a new facade or Workspace::execute read path

presentation.scope: Five logical responsibility areas, represented by existing model elements. Broader captions and aggregate status are view-only; detailed responsibility identities/status/source paths and all 56 relationships remain in this catalogue and the model. No new crates, services or application behavior.
presentation.omitted_from_diagram: Feature-level document/graph/history/annotation calls and planned adapter-specific policy/storage wiring remain in the detailed model. Protected reads are aggregated at the logical application area; they are not routed through Workspace::execute.

internal_audit.scope: Five areas with frontend/keychain/crypto details expanded; protected reads aggregated at the application area without a new facade or call through Workspace::execute; explicit default passphrase path shown.
internal_audit.curve_policy: Single smooth cubic Bezier per connector, no elbow waypoints
